3.name: Spellcasting
3.notes:
You have learned to cast spells using the rules of spellcasting from chapter 7.

Cantrips. You know two Wizard cantrips of your choice. Recommended: Ray of Frost and Shocking Grasp. You can replace one cantrip whenever you gain a Fighter level. At level 10, you learn an additional Wizard cantrip.

Spell Slots. You use the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table to determine how many spell slots you have. All expended slots return when you finish a Long Rest.

Prepared Spells. You prepare three level 1 Wizard spells at level 3. Recommended: Burning Hands, Jump, Shield. Your number of prepared spells increases as shown in the subclass table. Prepared spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. When you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one prepared spell.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

3.name: War Bond
3.notes:
You perform a 1-hour ritual (Short Rest allowed) to create a magical bond with a weapon. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is attuned by another creature.

Once bonded, you cannot be disarmed of the weapon unless Incapacitated. If the weapon is on the same plane, you can summon it as a Bonus Action, teleporting it immediately to your hand.

You can bond with up to two weapons but can summon only one at a time. Bonding a third weapon breaks an existing bond of your choice.

7.name: War Magic
7.notes: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a casting of a Wizard cantrip that has a casting time of 1 action.

10.name: Eldritch Strike
10.notes: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

15.name: Arcane Charge
15.notes: When you use your Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action provided by Action Surge.

18.name: Improved War Magic
18.notes: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.
